realm_description: Not a fixed place, but what Maruto becomes when civilization falls out of balance. Harai is temporary by nature — when balance returns, it transforms back into Maruto, a cycle called The Great Turning.

primary.label: Reformer
primary.description: Driven by justice, dreads stagnation more than backlash.
primary.guiding_promise: I will not accept a broken world when a better one is possible.
primary.shadow_description: Burns down what was merely imperfect, mistaking any resistance for the enemy.

secondary.label: Scout
secondary.description: Goes first into the unknown and turns fear of it into momentum.
secondary.guiding_promise: I go first — so others know the way is possible.
secondary.shadow_description: Leaps first so often they stop checking whether anyone can actually follow.

wheel.central_question: Should we preserve the system, or change it?

growth.label: Scout
growth.description: Goes first into the unknown and turns fear of it into momentum.

other_ally.label: Warden
other_ally.description: Guards boundaries that others don't even know exist; constant, thankless watch.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will hold this line, long after everyone else has forgotten why it matters.
other_ally.shadow_description: Stands watch so long they start seeing threats at a threshold nothing is actually crossing.

quarter.label: Explorer
quarter.description: Fears limitation more than the unknown; needs to discover.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will go where no map exists and make my own path.
quarter.shadow_description: Never stays anywhere long enough to build something that could have lasted.

opposite.label: Bureaucrat
opposite.description: Finds safety and fairness in process, dreads chaos.
opposite.guiding_promise: I build the structures that protect what matters from chaos.
opposite.shadow_description: Clings to the process long after it stops serving the people it was built to protect.

wheel.compatible_text: Warden · Pathfinder — fellow travelers of The Broken Heart.
